nativeConsumerEvidence.readBehavior: Fetch force-cache, allocate exact compressed size, read through EOF, cancel reader in finally, reject excess/truncated bytes. The proposed worker copies this exact six-line function.
nativeConsumerEvidence.bootChain: moon-native.mjs:180 sets ready=true only on the owned worker ready message. moon-worker.mjs:15-16 reads both assets then awaits MoonPool.create; :64 sends ready only after that resolves. moon-pool.mjs:37-40 awaits all four shard-ready promises. moon-worker.mjs:43 makes each shard ready only after MoonEngine.create, whose decodeAsset at moon-engine.mjs:39-41 validates compressed length/SHA-256 before decode and initialization.
nativeConsumerEvidence.boundedInference: The failed Chromium B readback binds Moon workerId 1, ready=true, reachable/nonterminated and boot/render messages to this chain. Together with exact served colour bytes, this is source-supported evidence against equating the transport failure notification with incomplete colour consumption. It is not direct native per-fetch EOF telemetry and does not yet isolate the cause of the notification.

prospectiveControlReview.consumer: One minimal fresh worker context reads both exact pinned compressed assets concurrently using the native read function and verifies their full SHA-256. No Moon renderer, terrain kernel, product page, providers, callbacks benchmark or timing verdict is executed.

prospectiveControlReview.termination: No automatic repetition; four declared contexts maximum, stop remaining contexts on acquisition exception. A returned consumer ERROR remains an error observation, not READ_AND_DIGEST_OK. Context/browser/Playwright closure, cumulative exact-identity cleanup and unchanged pins are required for a complete observation record.
prospectiveControlReview.shutdownSeparation: Interpret request event endedAt against observationEndedAt and contextCloseStartedAt. Count only attributable events before context close as acquisition observations. Shutdown-associated, missing-terminal or ambiguous events cannot establish transport causality.
fidelityLimits: The reader and compressed bytes are exact; this is not the full four-shard native engine, decompression/terrain pipeline or original callback acquisition.
Both arms retain cancel-after-EOF; the control tests interception under that consumer, not the independent causal necessity of reader.cancel().
Fresh contexts and no-store responses keep this a cold local transfer comparison; it does not validate warm-cache behavior.
Four runs can support a bounded reproduced association, not a population frequency or performance result.
